run_grpc_worker_server: run a gRPC Python performance testing worker server on a specified port
run_worker_with_uvloop: run the gRPC worker server with uvloop as the event loop for better performance
start_async_grpc_server: start an async gRPC server that registers the WorkerService servicer and listens on a port
review_run_worker_server: review the run_worker_server async function that initializes and manages the gRPC aio server lifecycle
refactor_worker_cli: refactor the worker CLI to support additional command-line arguments for the gRPC performance testing worker
